text:
Carmen: Kicking off a cautious blue->green shift for release v3.2.1 in eu-west. plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% over 20m windows. change window is now.
Raj: ack. which routes are affected?
Carmen: router-prod: model-routing rule 'text-gen' and 'chat' lanes. no DB schema changes.
Taylor: tagging rollback criteria: 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 900ms for 5m. otherwise proceed.
sre-oncall: noted. I'll watch infra metrics + request logs.
deploy-bot: START: traffic-shift v3.2.1 namespace=eu-west initial_weight=10% initiated_by=@Carmen
Carmen: command we used for the router if anyone needs to replay:
```
rbctl router set-weight --env=prod --region=eu-west --route=text-gen --target-version=v3.2.1 --weight=10
```
Leo: running smoke tests against green nodes now, will post failures here.
Raj: can we pin session affinity to avoid cross-version sticky sessions? iirc that bit was toggled last time.
Taylor: good call — affinity remains enabled for 30m. pinging ops to verify cookie TTL.
sre-oncall: saw a small p95 blip at +1m but back down. continuing to observe.
deploy-bot: SHIFT PROGRESS: v3.2.1 -> 10% (0->1m) OK
Carmen: moving to 25% in 5m if stable. I updated the release notes with the rollout steps and notes on model tokenizer change.
Leo: smoke tests passed on green cluster for 25/30 samples.
Raj: remind me where the quick rollback command is, and who executes if we hit criteria?
Taylor: rollback command (ops reserved):
```
rbctl router set-weight --env=prod --region=eu-west --route=text-gen --target-version=v3.2.1 --weight=0
rbctl router set-weight --env=prod --region=eu-west --route=text-gen --target-version=v3.1.9 --weight=100
```
Taylor: Oncall or release lead can execute. if automated trigger fires, deploy-bot will announce.
sre-oncall: 3m window now — enabling detailed tracing and dropping perf samples to S3 for deep dive.
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary ERROR_RATE=text-gen=1.2% (3m avg) threshold exceeded. automated pause engaged at 1745234780
Carmen: pausing manual progression. rolling back to v3.1.9 now.
Taylor: executing rollback commands. tagging this event in the release notes and support ticket.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED: v3.2.1 -> v3.1.9 initiated_by=@Taylor
Leo: confirming traffic shifting back to 100% stable nodes.
sre-oncall: post-rollback checks: 5xx down to baseline, p95 latency returned to ~420ms.
Carmen: good. opening a short postmortem doc for quick follow-up on tokenizer variant and edge-case prompt that triggered the canary.
Raj: add a note to consider a smaller intermediate canary next time (5% steps) and a longer warmup for KV caches.
Taylor: agreed. I'll update the rollout ops checklist and add the exact rollback commands to the release notes.
deploy-bot: EVENT CLOSED: rollback completed at 1745234869. summary: pause->rollback due to canary error_rate breach.
Carmen: thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30-min retro in 1h to go over telemetry and release notes updates. :thumbsup:
